modernizationFindings.title: EXEC SQL without SQLCODE / SQLSTATE check
modernizationFindings.description: Embedded SQL with no SQLCODE / SQLSTATE inspection after the call and no WHENEVER directive in effect. Unhandled SQL errors are a common source of silent data corruption in COBOL.
modernizationFindings.suggestedReplacement:
EXEC SQL ... END-EXEC.
    IF SQLCODE NOT = ZERO
        PERFORM HANDLE-SQL-ERROR
    END-IF.

files.description: Processes financial transactions from an input file, updates a SQL ledger table, and produces an audit output file.
responsibilities: Read transaction records from TXN-IN file
Validate and process each transaction
Update the TXN_LEDGER SQL table for each transaction
Write audit information to AUDIT-OUT file
Handle file open/close operations and EOF scenarios

algorithm.details: Prepare for processing by opening the necessary files.
Iterate through each transaction, apply logic, and track results.
Insert transaction information into TXN_LEDGER table.
Log details about each transaction into the audit file.
